# Project doc pack

Formalize only approved decisions. A technical spec covers boundaries, modules, runtime/data flows, integrations, deployment/reliability, and failures. A UX doc covers goals, IA, flows, screens, components, interactions, responsive/accessibility, and visual guidance. A plan has phases, dependencies, tasks, and verification checkpoints.

Do not decide on behalf of the originating plugin. Exit with linked IDs and clear verification status.
